test_harness_correction.original_issue: The monitor package fixture assumed host temporary bind mounts, which the isolated Premium daemon intentionally cannot access. Two starts were rejected before monitor code ran.
test_harness_correction.correction: Transfer bounded synthetic test modules through stdin into container tmpfs; retain network none, read-only root, non-root user, scoped synthetic Unix daemon, CPU/memory/swap/PID bounds and label-checked cleanup. No runtime image or isolation policy changed.

limits: A killed process/container cannot promise a terminal database write. The retained running record remained honest; duplicate response was unknown with no new upstream attempt.

Same-Mac dump/reconstruction is not off-device backup acceptance.
No inference semantics, Connect policy, quota arithmetic, production image, active configuration or route changed.
